name: v91_nip_earnings_cashflow_lowcorr_no_open
hypothesis: The v86 NIP earnings/cashflow candidate is very strong but barely above the strict corr gate; removing daily open-close and adding risk/forward-carry sleeves may change the return path enough to pass.
expression: 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.14 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.08 * group_rank(ts_rank((close - forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry)

name: v91_css_earnings_cashflow_short_relief
hypothesis: CSS earnings has similar strength to NIP but a slightly different news path; short-interest and beta relief replace part of the crowded reversal/cashflow exposure.
expression: 0.32 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.14 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v91_earnings_calm_trade_when
hypothesis: Only refreshing the earnings/cashflow signal in calmer absolute-return regimes may lower overlap with the payout/reversal ACTIVE path while retaining the earnings-news edge.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.65, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.12 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v91_forward_curve_no_dividend
hypothesis: Forward-curve carry was strong but hit the fscore/reversal path; removing dividend and open-close should test whether the forward curve itself has standalone low-corr information.
expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank((close - forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((forward_price_30 - forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v91_forward_curve_product_residual
hypothesis: Pairing forward carry with product/business news rather than dividend/reversal may test a different event-confirmed carry route.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank((close - forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank((forward_price_60 - forward_price_360) / close, 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_product, 90), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_business, 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.08 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v91_antidilutive_no_dividend_social
hypothesis: Antidilutive overhang was strong but mapped to payout/deferred-revenue; removing dividend/reversal and adding social/risk sleeves may separate dilution relief from shareholder-yield exposure.
expression: 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * antidilutive_securities_eps_exclusion_count / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fn_antidilutive_securities_excl_from_eps_a / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_soe_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_soe_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v91_stockcomp_forward_relief
hypothesis: A small forward-carry sleeve may change stock-compensation overhang timing enough to avoid the old payout/accounting-quality path.
expression: 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * shares_issued_stock_options_exercised / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank((close - forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v91_ptp_product_credit_residual
hypothesis: PTP estimate confidence was just over the corr gate; product and credit-rating news may provide a non-EPS confirmation path without daily reversal.
expression: 0.26 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_low) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_product, 90), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
